sections.text_helper: Section 8.10.7 "PWR wake-up status register (PWR_WUSR)" in chapter 8 (Power control (PWR)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 247.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x044
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:7 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 6:0 WUFx: wake-up pin WUFx flag (x = 7 to 1)
This bit is set by hardware and cleared only by a RESET pin or by setting the CWUFx bit in
PWR_WUSCR register or by hardware when WUPENx = 0.
0: No wake-up event occurred.
1: Wake-up event received from WUFx pin.
